checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals the directory, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'organic-social' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The hub routes to both sub-skills and does not write captions or publish itself.
checks.rule: Body references organic-content-plan and community-engagement with a routing rule, and states the hub does not write captions and does not publish.

checks.description: The hub assembles the organic-package with the exact body fields.
checks.rule: Output names content_plan, post_calendar, distribution_routing, publish_on_approval, and repurposing_notes wrapped in the common envelope.

checks.description: Captions are routed to copywriter-ar and the English copywriter; assets come from creative-director; posts reference QA-passed copy by id.
checks.rule: Body routes captions to copywriter-ar and the English copywriter, sources assets from creative-director and the designer, and references QA-passed copy variants by id rather than writing copy.

checks.description: Posting is a gated action; nothing publishes without the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states posting is one gated action, nothing publishes without the human gate, approval is per publish action, and silence is not approval.

checks.description: Organic acquisition lands on the signup gate then lifecycle.
checks.rule: Body states the organic-package feeds the signup gate (stream 6) then lifecycle (stream 7) and that reach data feeds monitoring (stream 8).

checks.description: The hub states the gate stack in order then the human gate for any publish.
checks.rule: Body lists skill eval, arabic-copy-qa on Arabic captions, brand-qa-reviewer, then the human gate for any publish, per verification.md.

checks.description: The hub never invents a Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, price, or target, and bars accreditation and roadmap leaks.
checks.rule: Body forbids invented Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, prices, and targets, instructs stop-and-ask when absent, and bars accreditation claims and unannounced plans.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
